pages.text: Two settlers today; a server tomorrow. The habits that scale:$(br2)Claim before you build. Mark deposits and towns on the shared atlas. Leave the capital's farms replanted. Do not force-load what you are not using. Kill a boss with friends: a Blueprint drops for every fighter, plus a spare for someone who could not come.

If the server stalls: note the time and what you were doing, and tell the admin. The watchdog keeps a dump; the time is what finds the cause.$(br2)If something looks wrong in a recipe or a tooltip, $(bold)/kubejs errors$() and a screenshot.
